added: packages/search: @sos-2/search — the CandidateSearchEngine CONTRACT (a stable interface with swappable implementations: the §10 ladder engine and a fixed-altitude alternative; engines are replaceable reasoning mechanisms, never authorities). The reasoning-altitude ladder is machine-enforced: candidate generation starts at VALIDATED_COMPOSITION and descends one rung at a time only when the higher rung cannot satisfy mission + constraints, with the altitude used and every descent justification recorded (unjustified descents, skipped rungs and traces continuing past a satisfied rung are REJECTED). Hard constraints filter candidates BEFORE evaluation through the typed constraint set consumed from mission/value-shaped views (duck-typed — real @sos-2/mission MissionConstraint objects satisfy the view directly; soft constraints never machine-veto; UNCHECKED axes are surfaced, never conflated with satisfaction). Exploration/exploitation is EXPLICIT: a REQUIRED typed policy knob (GREEDY / seeded EPSILON_GREEDY / UCB-shaped bandit over the diverse candidate set using applicability-estimate uncertainty — calibrated probabilities, sample sizes, qualitative classes); the policy orders and annotates, never drops candidates; family representatives always survive caps

packages/optimization: @sos-2/optimization — multi-objective Pareto evaluation (non-dominated sorting over typed objectives on the §11 dimensions imported from @sos-2/packages, six core axes with frozen natural directions; returns the Pareto FRONT — every mutually non-dominated candidate — and the fronts PARTITION the input; no single-winner API exists) and the Quality-Diversity repertoire (a MAP-Elites-style archive: typed behavior descriptors, per-cell elites, deterministic order-independent/confluent archive updates; materially different high-performing solution families retained, never collapsed). Uncertainty is preserved end-to-end: every candidate MUST carry a CarriedUncertainty payload (qualitative class + sample size + calibrated probability ONLY with its calibration ref); uncertainty-stripped candidates and uncalibrated numerics are REJECTED

packages/retrieval: @sos-2/retrieval — the retrieval facade over @sos-2/registry (the registry stays THE data authority, injected and never duplicated): composes registry results into search context with uncertainty (verbatim, never stripped), evidence context (resolved where possible; unresolved never reported as zero), learned limitations and failure contexts surfaced per candidate, plus composition OWN-evidence views (own refs, members, justified independence assessments; member evidence never substitutes — evaluateCompositionOwnEvidence delegates to the W6 authority and marks member-subject evidence FOREIGN; combinedCompositionProbability rejects unjustified member-probability multiplication). The Bayesian update path: betaUpdate (delegating the Beta math to @sos-2/packages' betaQuantile — with the default Beta(1,1) prior exactly the authority's betaPosterior), updateApplicabilityEstimate (calibrated estimates update from their implied-counts prior and stay calibrated; qualitative estimates contribute NO invented numeric prior and stay qualitative without new calibration evidence), and dirichletUpdate for multi-category counts — all preserving sample size and time window, with numeric outputs marked UNCALIBRATED unless calibration evidence is attached
packages/search/W7.architecture-delta.json: this Architecture Delta record (validated by the spine's assertValidArchitectureDelta in packages/search/test/delta.test.ts)
preserved_invariants: no second semantic/evidence/package authority: the §10 altitude ladder, retrieval ranking and the registry itself come from @sos-2/registry (composed through @sos-2/retrieval, never redefined); the uncertainty-class vocabulary comes from @sos-2/evidence; applicability/context/diversity vocabularies come from @sos-2/packages; composition disciplines come from @sos-2/composition; the Beta math authority stays in @sos-2/packages; spine ids and canonical serialization come from @sos-2/semantic-spine

never a single global architecture score as the sole authority (spec/architecture-lock.md): search returns the diverse candidate set (family representatives always present); Pareto returns the FRONT with the fronts partitioning the input; the MAP-Elites repertoire retains materially different high-performing families — a universal winner collapsing the repertoire does not exist in any API

spec/architecture.md §10 retrieval order is honored: candidate generation starts at the highest safe validated abstraction (validated composition -> validated package -> package adaptation -> architecture pattern -> novel architecture -> low-level synthesis) and descends ONLY with a recorded justification for every step; the engine records the altitude used

spec/architecture.md §12 probabilistic semantics: uncertainty is preserved end-to-end (qualitative class + sample size + calibrated probability only with calibration ref, carried through search, Pareto and the repertoire; results never collapse to point scores alone); composition success is never inferred from member probabilities without justified independence; numeric Bayesian outputs are marked uncalibrated unless calibration evidence is attached

hard constraints outrank preferences (§18): only HARD bounded constraints machine-filter candidates BEFORE evaluation; soft constraints are preferences and never veto; unknown estimates are UNCHECKED — distinct states (satisfied/violated/unchecked) are never conflated

compositions require their own evidence (§18, locked invariant): the retrieval facade surfaces composition own-evidence views and delegates evaluation to the W6 authority — member evidence never substitutes (negative-tested)
the 6 evidence truth states remain distinct; unresolved evidence refs are reported as unresolved, never as zero or absence-of-failure (the facade surfaces the registry's honest views verbatim)
existing frozen contracts and the merged W0.5-W6 packages are unchanged; the change is additive within the W7 owned paths packages/search, packages/optimization, packages/retrieval

LLM output is never authoritative evidence or authorization; engines are replaceable reasoning mechanisms behind the CandidateSearchEngine contract (the reference stack's candidate-search contracts), never authorities
boundary_changes: new workspace packages @sos-2/search, @sos-2/optimization, @sos-2/retrieval (dependency chain: registry -> retrieval -> search; optimization depends on packages/evidence/spine only — no cycles, no sibling modifications)
@sos-2/search consumes mission-shaped constraint views by duck typing (no runtime dependency on @sos-2/mission; real mission constraints proven compatible in the integration test)
